units.source_text: 祖父在昭宪皇太后御葬那天晚上与世长辞。

en.t: My grandfather passed away on the night of Empress Dowager Shoken's funeral.

units.source_text: 那是我十六岁那年的夏天。

en.t: It was the summer of the year I turned sixteen.

units.source_text: 祖父弥留之际，痰堵气管，心如刀绞，痛苦万状。

en.t: As my grandfather lay dying, phlegm blocked his windpipe, his heart seemed wrung by knives, and he suffered terribly.

units.source_text: 一位坐在祖父枕边的老太婆嘟哝说：

en.t: An old woman sitting by my grandfather's pillow muttered:

units.source_text: “像佛爷一般的人，临终为什么这般痛苦呢？”

en.t: Why should a man like a Buddha suffer so much at the end?

units.source_text: 我目不忍睹这般苦楚的情状，待不到一小时，就躲到另一个房间去了。

en.t: Unable to bear the sight of such agony, I slipped away to another room before even an hour had passed.

units.source_text: 我是他唯一的亲人，我这样做未免太寡情了。

en.t: I was his only family, and what I did was surely far too heartless.

units.source_text: 事隔一年，一位表姐这样责怪我。

en.t: A year later, one of my older female cousins reproached me in that way.

units.source_text: 我觉得人家这样看我是理所当然的。

en.t: I felt it was only natural for others to see me that way.

units.source_text: 我少年时代，很不喜欢无根无据地进行自我辩解。

en.t: When I was young, I strongly disliked making groundless excuses for myself.

units.source_text: 再说，老太婆的话严重地挫伤了我。

en.t: Besides, the old woman's words had wounded me deeply.

units.source_text: 所以我觉得，哪怕说明一下我离开临终的祖父的原因，也可以洗雪祖父的耻辱。

en.t: So I felt that even explaining why I had left my dying grandfather's side might clear away the shame cast on him.

units.source_text: 然而，我受到表姐的责怪，沉默不语，一种无依无靠的寂寞感猛然侵袭我的心头，直渗入心灵深处。

en.t: Yet when my cousin reproached me and I kept silent, a helpless loneliness suddenly seized my heart and sank deep into my soul.
I felt utterly alone and forlorn.
